models.name: fct_daily_prices
models.description: Main analysis table. Grain: one row per card x marketplace (source) x variant x price_date, only rows with a market price. Adds day-on-day change and trailing 7-calendar-day statistics for spike detection. Use this table for price questions.

columns.name: price_key
columns.description: Surrogate key, md5 of card_id, source, variant and price_date.

columns.name: price_date
columns.description: Date the prices were collected (one partition of the raw lake).

columns.name: card_id
columns.description: TCGdex card id, e.g. sv03.5-006. Unique per printed card, not per variant.

columns.name: set_id
columns.description: TCGdex set id, e.g. sv03.5 (151), sv08.5 (Prismatic Evolutions), sv10 (Destined Rivals).

columns.name: card_name
columns.description: Card name as published by the source API. Free text from an external system.

columns.name: rarity
columns.description: Rarity label from the source, e.g. Common, Double rare.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Marketplace the price comes from, cardmarket or tcgplayer.

columns.name: variant
columns.description: Print variant, e.g. normal, holo (cardmarket) or holofoil, reverse-holofoil (tcgplayer).

columns.name: currency
columns.description: EUR for cardmarket, USD for tcgplayer.

columns.name: low
columns.description: Lowest current listing price.

columns.name: mid
columns.description: Median listing price (tcgplayer only).

columns.name: high
columns.description: Highest listing price (tcgplayer only).

columns.name: market
columns.description: Headline price in the row's currency (EUR for cardmarket, USD for tcgplayer).

columns.name: trend
columns.description: Cardmarket trend price (cardmarket only).

columns.name: avg7
columns.description: Cardmarket 7-day average sell price, as reported by cardmarket.

columns.name: avg30
columns.description: Cardmarket 30-day average sell price, as reported by cardmarket.

columns.name: source_updated_at
columns.description: When the marketplace last refreshed this price.

columns.name: prev_market
columns.description: Market price exactly one calendar day earlier; null if that day is missing.

columns.name: avg_prev_7d
columns.description: Average market price over the 7 calendar days before price_date.

columns.name: sd_prev_7d
columns.description: Sample standard deviation of market price over the same 7 days.

columns.name: n_prev_7d
columns.description: Number of prior days with a price inside the 7-day window.

columns.name: day_change_pct
columns.description: Percent change vs exactly yesterday; null when yesterday is missing.

columns.name: zscore_7d
columns.description: (market - avg_prev_7d) / sd_prev_7d. How unusual today's price is vs the past week.

columns.name: is_spike
columns.description: True when abs(zscore_7d) >= 3, there are at least 5 prior days in the window, and the price (or its average) is at least 2 in its currency.

models.name: price_spikes
models.description: Rows of fct_daily_prices where is_spike is true, exported to the lake for alerting. Grain: one row per spiking card x marketplace x variant x price_date.
